module_summary: AXI-lite write-to-register-interface bridge: latches AW and W beats, issues a register write enable, and returns BVALID on ack or timeout counter expiry.

anchors.name: s_axil_awvalid
anchors.why: Write address valid captured into awvalid holding flag.

anchors.name: s_axil_awready
anchors.why: Address ready while no address is held.

anchors.name: s_axil_wvalid
anchors.why: Write data valid captured into wvalid holding flag.

anchors.name: s_axil_wready
anchors.why: Data ready while no write data is held.

anchors.name: s_axil_bvalid
anchors.why: Write response valid set on register ack or timeout.

anchors.name: s_axil_awvalid_reg
anchors.why: Address-held flag gating awready, address capture and write enable.

anchors.name: s_axil_wvalid_reg
anchors.why: Data-held flag gating wready and data capture.

anchors.name: reg_wr_addr
anchors.why: Register write address from held AXI address.

anchors.name: reg_wr_data
anchors.why: Register write data from held AXI data.

anchors.name: reg_wr_strb
anchors.why: Register write byte strobes from held wstrb.

anchors.name: reg_wr_en
anchors.why: Register write request asserted while address and data held.

anchors.name: reg_wr_ack
anchors.why: Register write acknowledge completing transaction and raising bvalid.

anchors.name: timeout_count_reg
anchors.why: Timeout counter completing write when register never acks.

groups.name: AXI-lite write slave
groups.description: AW/W/B channel handshakes with OKAY response.

groups.name: Write holding registers
groups.description: Hold address, data, strobe and valid flags until write completes.

groups.name: Register write port
groups.description: Issues register write enable and waits for ack.

groups.name: Timeout
groups.description: Countdown forcing completion when no ack arrives.
